Abstract: Model merging aims to combine multiple domain-specialized experts trained from a shared foundation model into a single multi-task model. Existing approaches largely focus on improving the merging procedure itself and typically assume experts obtained through full-parameter fine-tuning. In this work, we revisit expert training for model merging. We first show that prompt-based adaptation provides a strong baseline: independently learned prompts can be exploited across tasks while keeping the backbone fixed, avoiding the interference introduced by weight merging. Building on this observation, we introduce Dual-Tuned Experts (DTEs), a two-stage training strategy that first learns prompts and then fine-tunes the vision encoder. This reduces the magnitude of task-specific parameter updates and produces experts with higher merge compatibility. Experiments across multiple CLIP architectures, full fine-tuning, and LoRA experts show that DTEs consistently improve merged performance of standard merging approaches and remain effective even when combining heterogeneous sets of experts.

</details>


### [168] [Face Recognition with Machine Learning in OpenCV_ Fusion of the results with the Localization Data of an Acoustic Camera for Speaker Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.00835)
*Johannes Reschke,Armin Sehr*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文概述了人脸识别算法及其实现与实际应用，通过训练集构建人脸模型进行个体分类，并结合声源定位实现实时场景描述，为多通道语音增强等应用提供支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了将人脸识别与声源定位相结合，实现对话场景中说话人的精确识别与实时状态分析，从而支持更高级的语音处理应用（如自适应波束形成的多通道语音增强）。

Method: 首先收集不同人脸的训练集训练人脸识别器，得到人脸模型用于个体/未知分类；然后结合人脸跟踪与声源位置估计，判断说话人身份及其是否在说话。

Result: 实现了对场景的精确实时描述，包括识别说话人并判断其是否在说话，可用于自适应波束形成等后续应用。

Conclusion: 人脸识别与声源定位的融合能够提供精确的实时场景描述，有效服务于多通道语音增强等实际应用。

Abstract: This contribution gives an overview of face recogni-tion algorithms, their implementation and practical uses. First, a training set of different persons' faces has to be collected and used to train a face recognizer. The resulting face model can be utilized to classify people in specific individuals or unknowns. After tracking the recognized face and estimating the acoustic sound source's position, both can be combined to give detailed information about possible speakers and if they are talking or not. This leads to a precise real-time description of the situation, which can be used for further applications, e.g. for multi-channel speech enhancement by adaptive beamformers.

</details>


### [169] [NSL-SLAM: High-Fidelity Neural Structured-Light Depth for Practical SLAM and Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24495)
*Jiaheng Li,Binsheng Zhang,Xinhai Chang,Wenzheng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NSL-SLAM是一个专为高质量结构光深度设计的SLAM系统，通过融合单目深度先验将深度RMSE降低35%，并构建以深度为中心的SLAM管线，在合成和真实基准上均达到SOTA性能，且能以20.9 FPS在线运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构光相机广泛应用于深度感知设备，神经SL解码方法已显著提升深度质量，但现有的SLAM系统并未充分挖掘这种高质量深度信息的潜力。作者希望设计一个专门利用高保真结构光深度的SLAM系统，使深度估计与SLAM相互增强。

Method: 1) 深度估计增强：在神经结构光(NSL)方法基础上，融合强单目深度先验进行SL立体解码，降低深度RMSE 35%。2) 深度中心SLAM管线：以密集且度量精确的结构光深度作为主要跟踪信号，仅在几何退化情况下使用稀疏视觉对应，并采用轻量级光束法平差处理长程漂移。

Result: 在Replica-SL合成基准上，NSL-SLAM实现了最佳跟踪精度，重建F-score比SOTA基线高1.6点。在8个挑战性场景的真实基准中，是唯一在所有序列上避免灾难性失败的方法，轨迹偏差比选定基线低43.3%。系统在线运行速度为20.9 FPS。

Conclusion: 更强的结构光深度与以深度为中心的系统设计相结合，能够实现实用、鲁棒的SLAM系统，深度估计与SLAM之间形成正向循环增强。

Abstract: Structured-light (SL) cameras power depth sensing in millions of devices, and recent neural SL decoding methods have substantially improved their depth quality. SLAM systems can benefit greatly from such strong depth sensing, where reliable geometry enables stable tracking and faithful reconstruction. In this work, we present NSL-SLAM, a practical SLAM system tailored for high-fidelity structured-light depth. We first strengthen SL depth sensing: inspired by the neural structured-light (NSL) method, we further incorporate strong monocular depth priors into the SL stereo decoding, reducing depth RMSE by 35% on Replica-SL compared to NSL. We then build a depth-centric SLAM pipeline with this stronger depth: because structured-light geometry is dense and metrically accurate, we keep it as the primary tracking signal, and add only sparse visual correspondences for geometrically degenerate cases and lightweight bundle adjustment for long-range drift. Our depth estimator and SLAM design reinforce each other: stronger depth makes a simple SLAM pipeline effective, and the depth-centric pipeline ensures this advantage transfers to downstream reconstruction. Experimentally, on the synthetic Replica-SL benchmark, NSL-SLAM achieves the best tracking accuracy and improves reconstruction F-score by 1.6 points over the SOTA baseline under a shared-depth protocol. On a real benchmark of 8 challenging scenes, it is the only method that avoids catastrophic failure on all sequences while achieving 43.3% lower trajectory deviation than selected baselines. The SLAM system runs online at 20.9 FPS, demonstrating that stronger structured-light depth and depth-centric system design together enable practical, robust SLAM.

</details>


### [170] [DecoupleMix: Decoupled Ratio Search and Convex Allocation for Scalable VLM Data Recipes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24516)
*Jiahao Xie,Zhongbin Guo,Qianle Wang,Ruiqi Lu,Dongling Xiao,Wanxuan Sun,Cheng Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DecoupleMix框架，将VLM数据混合构建系统化为两个正交子问题：跨能力类别的比例分配（单变量迭代搜索）和类别内组成（基于质量和难度的约束凸优化），实现了可复现、可归因的数据工程，在80B多模态继续预训练token上达到与更大预算模型竞争的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前VLM预训练数据混合构建高度依赖启发式和直觉（堆叠通过质量过滤的数据集、凭经验设定跨领域比例），缺乏原则性、可归因的标准来接纳新数据，前沿配方也不公开，亟需将数据构建从艺术转变为可复现的工程学科。

Method: 将数据混合构建解耦为两个正交子问题：1) 跨类别（capability）比例分配：采用单变量迭代搜索优化；2) 类别内（intra-class）组成：基于数据集的"质量"和"难度"进行多维评估，建模为带多样性目标约束的凸优化问题。

Result: DecoupleMix在多个实验设置中一致超越启发式基线；在小规模代理上发现的最优比例可无缝迁移到更大规模而无需重新调参；使用80B多模态继续预训练token训练的VLM与使用更大多模态预算的强开源模型具有竞争力。

Conclusion: DecoupleMix提供了两个关键能力：指导下一步应收集什么数据，以及使数据集验证成为可控、可归因的实验。这为VLM数据混合构建提供了系统化、可复制的工程方案。

Abstract: While data curation for Vision Language Models (VLMs) is increasingly active, public practice for constructing pretraining mixtures remains largely heuristic: practitioners stack datasets that pass quality filters, set cross-domain ratios by intuition, and lack a principled, attributable criterion for admitting new data, while frontier recipes remain undisclosed. We formulate data construction as a systematic mixture-optimization problem and turn it into a reproducible engineering discipline by decoupling the mixture into two orthogonal sub-problems: inter-class ratios across capabilities and intra-class ratios within a category. For inter-class allocation, we use a single-variable iterative search; for intra-class composition, we apply a multidimensional, dataset-level assessment scoring Quality and Difficulty, and formulate selection as a constrained convex optimization with a diversity objective. The DecoupleMix framework delivers two critical capabilities: guiding what data to collect next and rendering dataset validation a controlled, attributable experiment. Experiments show our approach consistently surpasses heuristic baselines. Moreover, optimal ratios discovered on small-scale proxies transfer seamlessly to larger scales without retuning. Using 80B additional multimodal continue-pretraining tokens, our VLM is competitive with strong open-source models trained with substantially larger multimodal budgets.

</details>


### [171] [EgoPlay: Event-Triggered Video Editing for Egocentric Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24560)
*Jinjie Mai,Gordon Guocheng Qian,Willi Menapace,Arpit Sahni,Chaoyang Wang,Ashkan Mirzaei,Runjia Li,Sergey Tulyakov,Bernard Ghanem,Peter Wonka,Rameen Abdal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoPlay是一个事件触发的第一人称视频编辑模型，通过微调预训练的V2V扩散Transformer，在Ego4D等数据集上训练。它能够根据"当X发生时，执行Y"的提示，同时完成事件检测、时间约束和像素级编辑，在Ego4D基准上大幅超越现有方法，且GPU内存消耗更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有第一人称视频编辑方法通常将事件检测器与编辑器级联，导致流程复杂、效率低下，且无法处理事件触发式的编辑需求。作者希望构建一个端到端的模型，能够同时学习事件识别、时间约束和像素级编辑，并支持负样本和多事件提示。

Method: 基于预训练的视频到视频（V2V）扩散Transformer进行微调；构建了包含10.6万对事件触发视频片段-提示对的大规模数据集（含正触发、伪造触发负样本和多事件提示）；训练双向视频扩散编辑器并加入事件触发监督；推导出因果变体以支持逐块流式推理。

Result: 在Ego4D基准上，EgoPlay相比EgoEdit在编辑质量、视觉质量和背景一致性上分别提升17.7%、16.9%和16.4%；相比VLM引导的检测器-编辑器基线分别提升15.7%、14.5%和13.5%，同时GPU内存消耗不到后者一半。

Conclusion: EgoPlay证明了将事件检测、时间约束和视频编辑统一在一个端到端模型中的有效性，在事件触发式第一人称视频编辑任务上取得了显著优势，并且效率更高。

Abstract: We introduce EgoPlay, an event-triggered video-to-video editor for egocentric streams, obtained by fine-tuning a pretrained V2V diffusion transformer on event-conditioned data built primarily from Ego4D. Given a monocular video and an event-triggered prompt of the form "when X happens, do Y," EgoPlay infers whether and when event X occurs, preserves pre-event frames, and applies edit Y only to the post-event continuation. Rather than cascading a separate event detector with an editor, EgoPlay learns event recognition, temporal restraint, and pixel-level editing jointly in a single end-to-end model, while also handling negative and multi-event prompts. To support this, we construct a large-scale dataset of 106K event-triggered clip-prompt pairs spanning positive triggers, fabricated-trigger negatives, and multi-event prompts. We then train a bidirectional video diffusion editor with event-triggered supervision and derive a causal variant for chunk-by-chunk streamable inference. We further introduce an event-aware evaluation protocol that separately measures post-trigger editing quality, pre-trigger preservation, and false-trigger robustness. On the Ego4D benchmark, EgoPlay substantially outperforms EgoEdit, the state-of-the-art instruction-based egocentric video editing baseline, with relative gains of 17.7%, 16.9%, and 16.4% in editing quality, visual quality, and background consistency. It also surpasses a VLM-guided detector-editor baseline by 15.7%, 14.5%, and 13.5% on the same metrics, while using less than half the GPU memory.

</details>


### [172] [The Visual Bottleneck: Sparse-Frame Adaptation of MLLMs for Joint Spatial-Temporal Video Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24570)
*Jiameng Zhang,Srikanth Madikeri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对大规模视频平台中稀疏帧输入（8-16帧）与多模态大语言模型密集预训练（数百帧）之间的不匹配问题，系统研究了空间-时间视频定位的训练策略。研究发现视觉特征提取是主导瓶颈，仅微调最后三层ViT（占总参数4%）即可在稀疏帧下达到68.8% temporal mIoU，超过使用密集输入的零样本8B模型12.8个百分点。边界感知采样策略Hybrid16进一步带来26个点的提升。结论是训练策略主导模型规模：微调后的2B模型始终优于零样本8B模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模视频平台每小时处理数百万上传内容，审核系统需要在每个视频中定位违规发生的时间和位置。由于处理每一帧在规模上不可行，系统只能使用稀疏输入（每视频8-16帧），但最先进的多模态大语言模型在数百帧的密集序列上预训练，造成训练与部署条件的严重不匹配，导致性能严重下降（Qwen3-VL 8B模型在16帧下temporal mIoU从56.0%降至22.3%，相对退化60.2%）。

Method: 系统性地研究了稀疏帧输入下空间-时间视频定位的训练策略。具体包括：1) 对比视觉特征提取器微调与语言模型微调的效果；2) 仅微调最后三层ViT层（占总参数4%）；3) 提出边界感知采样策略Hybrid16，利用时间边界信息改善帧采样。

Result: 仅微调最后三层ViT层（4%参数）在稀疏帧下达到68.8% temporal mIoU，超过使用密集输入的零样本8B模型12.8个百分点。Hybrid16采样策略在可用时间边界条件下，比均匀采样提升26个百分点temporal mIoU。微调后的2B模型始终优于零样本8B模型。

Conclusion: 对于稀疏帧视频定位，训练策略主导模型规模。视觉特征提取是主要瓶颈，语言模型微调收益甚微甚至为负。边界感知采样能显著提升性能。

Abstract: Large-scale video platforms process millions of uploads hourly, requiring moderation systems that can localize when and where policy violations occur within each video. Processing every frame is infeasible at scale, so systems are constrained to sparse inputs of 8 to 16 frames per video. Yet state-of-the-art multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are pretrained on dense sequences of hundreds of frames, creating a fundamental mismatch between training and deployment conditions. This mismatch causes severe performance collapse: the Qwen3-VL 8B model drops from 56.0% to 22.3% temporal mIoU when frames are reduced to 16, a 60.2% relative degradation.
  We present a systematic empirical study of training strategies to close this gap for spatial-temporal video grounding. Our results suggest that visual feature extraction is the dominant bottleneck under sparse-frame inputs. Adapting only the final three ViT layers, 4% of total parameters, achieves 68.8% temporal mIoU and surpasses a zero-shot 8B model using dense inputs by 12.8 points. Language model fine-tuning, by contrast, offers negligible or negative returns. A boundary-aware sampling strategy, Hybrid16, further improves temporal mIoU by 26 points over uniform sampling when temporal boundaries are available. We conclude that for sparse-frame video grounding, training strategy dominates model scale: a fine-tuned 2B model consistently outperforms a zero-shot 8B model, with or without dense frame access.

</details>


### [173] [CADER: Confidence-Aware Dynamic Evidence Reasoning for Long-Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24582)
*Jinlong Yang,Wenhao Zhang,Kuanwei Lin,Sijie Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CADER是一个无需训练的框架，通过置信度感知的动态证据推理实现长视频自适应推理：简单问题只需全局推理快速退出，困难问题则激活工具增强循环（时间裁剪、语义验证、相关性引导重采样）来定位时序证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长视频理解系统对所有示例采用相同的推理流程，导致简单问题不必要地调用工具辅助处理，而困难问题又缺乏对细粒度时序证据的精准控制，缺乏根据问题难度自适应调整推理策略的能力。

Method: 1) 全局推理阶段：在均匀采样帧上进行推理，利用logit-margin信号估计答案置信度，高置信样本提前退出；2) 工具增强循环：对不确定样本依次执行时间裁剪、轻量级语义验证和相关性引导重采样，渐进定位问题相关证据；3) 将工具使用视为样本级决策，仅对需要更多证据的样本启用。

Result: 在多个VideoQA基准上，CADER提升了长视频推理性能，同时高置信样本跳过了阶段2；应用于仅使用无工具思维链监督训练的骨干模型时，达到了与专门工具增强框架竞争的性能。

Conclusion: CADER提出了一条实用的推理时自适应长视频推理路径，通过置信度驱动的动态策略在效率与准确性之间取得平衡，证明了无需额外训练即可实现自适应推理的可行性。

Abstract: Long-video understanding increasingly relies on large vision-language models and tool-augmented reasoning, but most systems apply the same inference procedure to every example regardless of difficulty. This uniform strategy invokes unnecessary tool-assisted processing for easy questions and provides limited control when difficult questions require fine-grained temporal evidence. We propose CADER (Confidence-Aware Dynamic Evidence Reasoning), a training-free framework for adaptive and reliable long-video reasoning. CADER first performs global reasoning over uniformly sampled frames and estimates answer confidence with a logit-margin signal, allowing high-confidence examples to exit early. For uncertain examples, CADER activates a second-stage tool-augmented loop that combines temporal cropping, lightweight semantic verification, and Relevance-Guided Resampling to progressively localize question-relevant evidence. This design treats tool use as a sample-level decision: a single global pass handles easy cases, while additional reasoning is reserved for examples where uncertainty suggests that more evidence is needed. Experiments on multiple VideoQA benchmarks show that CADER improves long-video reasoning while bypassing Stage~2 for high-confidence samples. Moreover, when applied to a backbone trained only with tool-free chain-of-thought supervision, CADER achieves competitive performance against specialized tool-augmented frameworks, suggesting a practical inference-time route for adaptive long-video reasoning.

</details>


### [174] [CameraAnything: Refilming Videos with Arbitrary Camera Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24591)
*Yixuan Li,Yanhong Zeng,Ka Leong Cheng,Jiayi Zhu,Hanlin Wang,Wen Wang,Yihao Meng,Hao Ouyang,Qiuyu Wang,Yue Yu,ZiDong Wang,Yiyuan Zhang,Yujun Shen,Dahua Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CameraAnything是首个统一框架，通过Plücker射线注入和3D RoPE，实现对相机内外参数的联合控制，支持任意视角、焦距、分辨率的视频编辑和重拍摄。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法要么依赖昂贵的3D重建实现完整相机控制，要么仅限外参操纵；内外参耦合使解耦建模困难；缺乏配对训练数据。

Method: 采用逐像素Plücker射线注入和分辨率感知3D RoPE自注意力机制，在目标潜空间上构建相机条件与空间位置编码；开发可扩展的合成数据管道，通过结构化多相机录制生成多样化动态场景；设计正交训练策略。

Result: 实现任意视点控制、焦距调整、分辨率适配及多镜头切换的单次生成，支持表达性视频重拍摄。

Conclusion: 为电影级视频编辑和跨平台内容适配提供了强实用价值的统一解决方案。

Abstract: We introduce CameraAnything, the first unified framework for camera controlled video editing that enables joint control of both intrinsic and extrinsic camera parameters. Existing approaches either rely on expensive 3D reconstruction to achieve full camera functionality or restrict editing to extrinsic parameter manipulation. Moreover, the coupled influence of intrinsic and extrinsic parameters on video appearance makes disentangled modeling particularly challenging. To address this, we adopt per-pixel Plücker ray injection alongside resolution-aware 3D RoPE in self-attention, building both camera conditioning and spatial positional encoding on the target latent to jointly control camera position, focal length, and native resolution editing without cropping or outpainting. To overcome the scarcity of paired training data, we further develop a scalable synthetic pipeline that constructs diverse dynamic scenes through structured multi-camera recording and generates synchronized videos with varied camera configurations. With a tailored orthogonal training strategy, CameraAnything enables expressive video reshooting with arbitrary viewpoint control, focal length adjustment, resolution adaptation, and multi-shot transitions within a single generation process, offering strong practical value for cinematic video editing and cross-platform content adaptation in video production.

</details>


### [175] [QueenVIS: Rethinking Image-Only Training for Video Instance Segmentation via Query Enrichment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24598)
*Arian Kheirandish,Fardin Ayar,Ehsan Javanmardi,Manabu Tsukada,Mahdi Javanmardi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: QueenVIS提出了一种查询中心框架，通过在单帧训练中引入特征预测损失和中心预测损失来增强对象查询质量，无需视频级监督即可实现与视频监督方法竞争的视频实例分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频实例分割方法大多依赖视频级监督和昂贵的身份一致性标注，而纯图像训练方法（如MinVIS）虽具潜力但发展不足，其瓶颈在于对象查询质量——仅通过单帧训练得到的查询在帧间漂移，导致关联不稳定。

Method: QueenVIS基于Mask2Former，在单帧训练中添加两个辅助头：1）特征预测损失，将每个查询与其实例的池化骨干描述符对齐；2）中心预测损失，注入空间结构。推理时丢弃这两个头（零参数增加），并通过无需训练的查询传播和记忆库方案维持时间身份一致性。

Result: 在YouTube-VIS和OVIS上（ResNet-50骨干），QueenVIS相比MinVIS提升显著：YouTube-VIS +6.7 AP，OVIS +4.8 AP，长序列YouTube-VIS +10.3 AP。最终在YouTube-VIS上达到50.9 AP，与近期视频监督SOTA竞争。

Conclusion: 增强对象查询的判别能力和时间稳定性是视频实例分割中一个重要且未被充分探索的方向，QueenVIS证明了无需视频训练即可达到与视频监督方法相当的性能。

Abstract: Video instance segmentation (VIS) requires models to detect, segment, and track object identities across frames, and most methods enforce temporal consistency through video-level supervision. Image-only training approaches, with MinVIS as one prominent example, have challenged this assumption, reaching competitive VIS without video training by treating frames as independent images and associating instances only at inference. The field has nonetheless moved toward ever more elaborate video-trained trackers, which depend on costly identity-consistent annotations, leaving the image-only direction under-explored. A diagnostic analysis identifies object query quality as the bottleneck: queries trained only to localize objects within a frame drift apart across frames and destabilize association. QueenVIS introduces a query-centric framework for strengthening image-trained VIS. During single-frame training, we enrich Mask2Former queries with two auxiliary heads: a feature-prediction loss that aligns each query with the pooled backbone descriptor of its instance, and a center-prediction loss that injects spatial structure. Both heads are discarded at inference, adding zero parameters, and temporal identity is maintained by a training-free query-propagation and memory-bank scheme. On YouTube-VIS and OVIS with a ResNet-50 backbone, QueenVIS improves over MinVIS, up to +6.7 AP on YouTube-VIS, +4.8 AP on OVIS, and +10.3 AP on the long-sequence YouTube-VIS split. QueenVIS achieves 50.9 AP on YouTube-VIS and remains competitive with recent video-supervised state-of-the-art, without processing a single video clip during training. Our findings suggest that strengthening the discriminative power and temporal stability of object queries is an important, underexplored axis for VIS. Code and models: https://github.com/ArianKheir/QueenVIS

</details>


### [176] [Test-Time Adaptation via Dual Distillation for Videos Under Severe Distribution Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24611)
*André Sacilotti,Samuel Felipe dos Santos,Jurandy Almeida*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TADD（测试时适应双蒸馏框架），通过轻量级投影适配器结合零样本蒸馏（对齐CLIP的域无关特征）和目标蒸馏（保留源域判别知识），在无需源数据的情况下实现视频的测试时域适应，在三个动作识别基准上超越现有方法，最高提升3.81%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型在真实场景中因分布偏移性能严重下降，现有测试时适应方法在处理连续时序数据（如视频）和严重域偏移时仍面临挑战，且很少有工作探索这种极端条件下的视频TTA。

Method: 提出TADD框架，包含一个轻量级投影适配器（唯一可更新组件），基于冻结的CLIP骨干网络，通过两种互补损失进行在线适应：(i)零样本蒸馏——对齐预训练VLM的域无关特征；(ii)目标蒸馏——保留适配器中编码的源域判别知识。

Result: 在UCF-HMDB、Daily-DA和Sports-DA三个视频动作识别基准的闭集场景下，TADD一致超越现有SOTA TTA方法，分别提升+3.81%、+2.63%和+3.03%。

Conclusion: TADD通过双蒸馏策略有效弥合视频域偏移，证明了轻量级适配器结合VLM知识在连续时序数据TTA中的有效性，为极端域偏移下的视频适应提供了新方案。

Abstract: Deep learning models have achieved state-of-the-art performance in several computer vision tasks. However, they experience severe performance degradation when applied to real-world scenarios due to unanticipated distribution shifts. Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) attempts to solve this problem by using unlabeled data from the target domain to dynamically adapt to the test distribution at inference time, without access to the source data. However, TTA remains a challenging problem when adapting to continuous, temporally correlated data, such as videos, and in scenarios where the target domain contains severe domain shifts. For this reason, few works in the literature explore TTA for videos under such extreme conditions. To overcome these limitations, we propose Test-time Adaptation via Dual Distillation (TADD), an online adaptation framework that relies on a lightweight projection adapter to bridge the domain gap. The adapter module is pre-trained on the source domain and then adapted to the target using our proposed complementary losses: (i) zero-shot distillation, which encourages alignment with the domain-agnostic features from a pre-trained vision-language model (VLM); and (ii) target distillation, which retains the source domain discriminative knowledge encoded in the pre-trained adapter. Built upon a frozen CLIP backbone, our method introduces this lightweight projection adapter as the sole updatable component during inference. We conducted extensive evaluations on three well-known video action recognition benchmarks: UCF-HMDB, Daily-DA, and Sports-DA. Our experiments in the closed-set scenario demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art TTA baselines. Notably, our TTA approach improves upon previous methods by up to +3.81% on UCF-HMDB, +2.63% on Daily-DA, and +3.03% on Sports-DA.

</details>


### [177] [Evidence Attribution in Visual Document Understanding without Coordinates or Region Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24651)
*Zhuchenyang Liu,Yao Zhang,Yu Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了视觉文档理解中的归因幻觉问题，发现传统坐标接口限制了模型表达证据的能力。作者提出语言接口（引用+检索）替代坐标接口，将证据召回率提升26-47点，幻觉率减半。并基于此设计了无需区域标注的GRPO训练方法，将8B模型的严格归因准确率从22.4提升至33.8。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉文档理解模型在坐标接口下即使答案正确也常无法定位正确证据区域（归因幻觉），本研究旨在探究这种失败是否部分源于坐标表达能力的限制，并寻找替代方案。

Method: 1. 对比两种接口：坐标接口（输出边界框）vs 语言接口（模型引用原文，多模态检索器通过布局解析器定位引用区域）；2. 在双语CiteVQA子集上对6个开源视觉语言模型进行对比实验；3. 基于语言接口设计GRPO训练方法：以法官对黄金答案与检索区域裁剪图的判断作为奖励，无需区域标注即可训练模型生成更好的证据引用。

Result: 语言接口相比坐标接口，证据召回率从最多8分提升至26-47分，幻觉率约减半，答案质量基本不变。GRPO训练将8B模型的严格归因准确率从22.4提升至33.8。

Conclusion: 研究表明，避免使用坐标接口且无需昂贵的区域级监督，即可显著改善视觉文档模型的归因能力，提供了一条提升归因质量的实用路径。

Abstract: Reliable visual document understanding requires a model to attribute each answer to the evidence regions that support it. Recent benchmarks and systems express this step through a coordinate interface: the model outputs the coordinates of bounding boxes that mark the evidence regions in the document. Under this interface, vision-language models often fail to identify the right regions even when the answer is correct, a failure known as Attribution Hallucination. We present a study that investigates whether this failure is partially limited by what the model can express through coordinates. On a verified bilingual CiteVQA subset, we compare the coordinate interface with a language interface in which the model outputs only text, quoting its evidence verbatim, and a multimodal retriever returns the location of each quote as a page region proposed by a layout parser (tables and figures are quoted through their captions or notes); the comparison is repeated over six open vision-language models. Compared with the coordinate interface, evidence recall rises from at most 8 points to between 26 and 47 and the hallucination rate roughly halves, with little change in answer quality. Building on this comparison, we use the same quote-and-retrieve pipeline as a training scaffold: because region-level evidence labels are expensive to collect for long documents, we introduce a GRPO recipe whose reward is a judge's reading of the gold answer and crops of the retrieved regions, training the model to quote better evidence without any region labels and raising an 8B backbone's strict attributed accuracy from 22.4 to 33.8. These findings indicate a practical path to improve attribution"without a coordinate interface and without costly region-level supervision.

</details>


### [178] [MMOE: Modernizing Diffusion Transformers with Efficient Expert Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24665)
*Yanhao Jia,Jiepeng Wang,Haibin Huang,Chi Zhang,Erik Cambria,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ModernMOE（MMOE），系统地将现代高效MoE组件（路由专家、共享专家、轻量级专家、门控残差路由、注意力残差信息复用）适配到SiT风格的扩散Transformer中。在单机8卡H100的有限预算下，MMOE在每一检查点均达到比稠密和中间稀疏专家基线更低的FID，收敛更快且质量-成本平衡更优。路由分析表明专家分工稳定，轻量级路由使用充分，去噪过程中路由变化平缓。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型通过容量增长与效率提升的平衡实现了可扩展性，但AIGC基础模型（AFMs）尤其是扩散Transformer虽已采用稀疏专家，却大多只追求增大总参数量和稀疏比率，而未引入使LLM扩展变得实用的效率机制，导致生成质量与训练/部署成本之间的平衡不足。因此，本文旨在探索能否将高效LLM扩展的架构原则更均衡地适配到AFMs中。

Method: 提出ModernMOE（MMOE），对SiT风格的扩散Transformer进行现代化改造，系统性地引入并组合了多种MoE组件：路由专家（routed experts）、共享专家和轻量级专家（shared & lightweight experts）、门控残差路由（gate-residual routing）、注意力残差信息复用（attention-residual information reuse）。所有实验在单机8卡H100、batch size 256、训练400k步的有限预算下进行，与稠密基线和中间稀疏专家基线进行公平比较。

Result: 在匹配的训练和采样协议下，MMOE在每一记录检查点均达到更低的FID（收敛速度更快）。在稀疏变体中，MMOE取得了最佳的质量-成本平衡。路由分析显示：专家在不同深度上稳定分工，轻量级路由被大量使用，去噪过程中相邻步骤的路由变化幅度较小。

Conclusion: AFMs可以通过引入经过验证的高效架构设计（而非简单地增加总参数量和稀疏比率）来跟随LLM的均衡扩展路径。这表明扩散Transformer的MoE设计应注重效率机制的系统整合而非单纯的规模扩大。

Abstract: Modern large language models scale successfully by pairing capacity growth with efficiency, keeping per-token and deployment costs under control as capacity grows. AIGC Foundation Models (AFMs), especially diffusion-transformer backbones, have begun to adopt sparse experts, but recent efforts mostly enlarge total parameter counts and sparsity ratios without importing the efficiency mechanisms that made LLM scaling practical, so generation quality is seldom balanced against training and deployment cost. This raises a natural question: can the architectural principles behind efficient LLM scaling be adapted to AFMs in a more balanced way? We introduce ModernMOE (MMOE), a modernization of SiT-style diffusion transformers that systematically adapts routed experts, shared and lightweight experts, gate-residual routing, and attention-residual information reuse to AIGC generation. Rather than treating MoE as a single plug-in replacement, MMOE studies how different modern expert components affect convergence, efficiency, and generation quality when composed inside a diffusion transformer. Every experiment in this paper is trained on a single eight-GPU H100 node with batch size 256 for 400k steps, an accessible single-machine budget. Under matched training and sampling protocols and at this budget, MMOE reaches lower FID at every recorded checkpoint, that is, it converges faster per training step, than dense and intermediate sparse-expert baselines, and among the sparse variants it attains the best quality-cost balance. Routing analysis further shows stable expert specialization across depth, substantial use of lightweight routes, and modest step-to-step routing changes during denoising. These results suggest that AFMs can follow the balanced scaling path of LLMs by importing proven efficiency designs, rather than by simply increasing total parameters and sparsity ratios.

</details>


### [179] [Co-Learning for Missing Arbitrary Modalities in Multi-modal Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24683)
*Francisco Mena,Dino Ienco,Roberto Interdonato,Cassio F. Dantas,Simon Besnard*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种多模态协同学习框架Co4Miss，解决训练与推理时模态任意缺失的问题。不同于传统融合方法，该方法通过特征级和决策级两种策略实现模态间协作，实验表明两种策略分别在少量缺失和极端缺失条件下表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实场景中（如传感器故障、隐私限制）模态在训练和推理时可能不一致，现有研究主要关注双模态数据融合，缺乏对任意多模态缺失场景的鲁棒处理方法。

Method: 提出多模态协同学习框架，包含两种替代方案：1）特征级信息利用方法；2）决策级信息利用方法。两者均不假设预定义的缺失模式，适应任意子集模态缺失的推理场景。

Result: 在两个多模态分类基准上，两种方法在不同缺失模态条件下均表现出显著的鲁棒性提升。方法一在单模态缺失的轻微缺失条件下更鲁棒，方法二在仅剩一个模态的极端缺失条件下表现更优。

Conclusion: 多模态协同学习框架有效解决了任意模态缺失问题，且不同策略适用于不同程度的缺失条件，为实际部署提供了灵活选择。

Abstract: Multi-modal classification leverages complementary information across diverse data sources to enhance predictive performance. However, real-world scenarios subject to operational constraints, such as sensor failures or privacy restrictions, lead to inconsistent modality availability between training and inference times. To handle missing modalities, prior studies have mainly covered bimodal data setups and focused on designing robust fusion processes. Instead, we adopt a multi-modal co-learning framework that prioritizes inter-modal collaboration rather than multi-modal fusion. Specifically, we consider that any subset of modalities may be absent, without assuming predefined missing-modality patterns, an inference scenario we refer to as missing arbitrary modalities. To address this challenge, we introduce two alternative approaches that leverage information at both feature- and decision-level. Experiments on two multi-modal classification benchmarks demonstrate significant robustness gains in various missing modality conditions. The first method shows more robust behavior under minimal missing conditions, where a single modality is absent, whereas the second performs better under extreme missing conditions, where all-but-one modalities are missing. Our code is available at https://github.com/fmenat/Co4Miss.

</details>


### [180] [Spatio-Temporal Conditional Denoising Transformer for Modality-Missing RGBT Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24701)
*Andong Lu,Ziyi Zha,Jiandong Jin,Shihao Li,Chenglong Li,Jin Tang,Bin Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种时空条件去噪Transformer（SCDT），通过联合利用长短时时间上下文作为条件，对缺失模态进行信息重建并对弱模态进行特征增强，同时引入噪声调制适应机制以统一处理模态缺失与完整场景下的RGBT跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RGBT跟踪方法在模态缺失时，数据恢复质量不佳且缺乏对缺失与完整场景的统一处理灵活性。

Method: 提出SCDT，包含：（1）利用短期时间线索捕获细粒度时间相关性，利用编码模态演化的长期时间线索捕获全局上下文；（2）以长短时时间上下文为条件，逐步引导可用模态的噪声特征学习可靠且时间一致的多模态表示；（3）引入噪声调制适应机制，根据模态可用性动态调整行为，统一处理模态缺失与完整场景。

Result: 在三个公开基准数据集上，该方法持续优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: SCDT能够有效应对模态缺失场景下的RGBT跟踪，通过统一的框架实现鲁棒的特征学习。

Abstract: Missing modalities in RGBT tracking often lead to incomplete and unstable multimodal feature representations that greatly degrade the performance. Existing methods typically attempt to recover missing modalities from available ones, but the quality of data generated in challenging scenarios might be unsatisfactory. In addition, current approaches exhibit limited flexibility in processing both missing and complete data. To overcome these limitations, we propose a Spatio-temporal Conditional Denoising Transformer (SCDT), which integrates the spatial cues and the temporal context to adaptively perform information reconstruction of missing modalities and feature enhancement of weak modalities in a unified framework, for robust modality-missing RGBT tracking. In particular, SCDT leverages the short-term temporal cues from recent historical frames to capture the fine-grained temporal correlations and the long-term temporal cues encoding modality evolution to capture the global context. By jointly exploiting long short-term temporal contexts as the conditions, SCDT progressively guides noisy features of available modalities to learn reliable and temporally consistent multimodal representations. Furthermore, SCDT introduces a noisemodulated adaptation mechanism that dynamically adjusts its behavior according to the modal availability, enabling a single framework to unify feature learning under both modality-missing and complete scenarios without changing the architecture or parameters. Extensive experiments on three public benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The code is available here.

</details>


### [181] [Panda: Unsupervised Pelvic Anomaly Detection for Real-Time MR Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24703)
*Anika Knupfer,Maximilian Lindholz,Johanna Paula Müller,Jordina Aviles Verdera,Smiti Tripathy,Susanne Schulz-Heise,Jana Hutter*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于Dinomaly的无监督异常检测框架，用于盆腔MRI实时异常检测。该方法利用冻结的DINOv3 Vision Transformer编码器、噪声MLP瓶颈和线性注意力解码器，通过编码器-解码器间的余弦距离生成空间异常图。在子宫肌瘤数据集上实现88.06%像素级AUROC和95.45%帧级特异性，处理速度40.5切片/秒，满足实时临床部署需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 女性盆腔疾病诊断常被延迟，盆腔MRI虽有优越的软组织对比度，但因生理运动、组织变形和器械伪影，实时异常检测仍具挑战性。现有监督方法因不良事件罕见、异质性强且难以标注而不切实际。

Method: 采用基于Dinomaly的无监督异常检测框架，使用冻结的DINOv3 Vision Transformer编码器，结合噪声MLP瓶颈和线性注意力解码器以防止恒等映射。通过编码器与解码器表示之间的逐token余弦距离来定位异常，生成空间异常图。

Result: 在子宫肌瘤数据集的精选子集上评估，像素级AUROC达88.06%，帧级特异性95.45%，处理速度40.5切片/秒。

Conclusion: 空间异常图和帧级评分可为放射科医生在主动操作过程中提供即时、局部的反馈，支持决策和自适应协议调整，满足实时临床部署要求。

Abstract: Female pelvic diseases remain an under researched area characterized by often delayed diagnosis. While pelvic MRI offers superior soft-tissue contrast for diagnosis and image-guided procedures, real-time anomaly detection remains challenging due to physiological motion, tissue deformation, and instrument artifacts. Existing supervised approaches are impractical, as adverse events are rare, heterogeneous, and difficult to annotate. We present a Dinomaly-based unsupervised anomaly detection framework adapted for pelvic MRI that learns normative representations from healthy cases and flags deviations without requiring labels. Our approach leverages a frozen DINOv3 Vision Transformer encoder combined with a noisy MLP bottleneck and Linear Attention decoder to prevent identity mapping while maintaining computational efficiency. Anomalies are localized via per-token cosine distance between encoder and decoder representations, yielding spatial anomaly maps that provide immediate feedback at the scanner to support radiologist decision-making and adaptive protocol adjustment. Evaluated on a curated subset of the Uterine Myoma Dataset, the framework achieves a pixel-level AUROC of 88.06% and high specificity (95.45%) at frame level at 40.5 slices/s, meeting real-time clinical deployment requirements. The spatial anomaly maps and frame-level scores provide immediate, localized feedback at the scanner to support radiologist decision-making and adaptive protocol adjustment during active procedures.

</details>


### [182] [SADe: Sparse-Atom Support Decontamination for Few-Shot Segmentation with Weak Support Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24706)
*Hang Xing,Guangjun Liu,Yan Xia,Xueming Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SADe是一个与预测器无关的支持去污染层，通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）的原子证据来估计弱标注支持补丁的可靠性，在不使用查询信息的情况下生成清洁的支持掩码，从而提升少样本分割（FSS）模型在弱监督场景下的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少样本分割（FSS）通常假设使用干净的像素级支持掩码，但在实际应用中，支持监督往往采用框、涂鸦、粗糙掩码或伪掩码等弱标注形式。这些弱标注可能包含纹理相似的干扰物和背景上下文，污染类别原型或视觉提示，从而影响查询预测的性能。

Method: 提出SADe层，核心是稀疏自编码器（SAE）原子证据：密集相似度可能同时响应目标和纹理相似上下文，而对比弱支持区域内外的原子激活提供因子级可靠性线索。轻量级路由器结合原子证据、密集相似度和episode统计信息来预测补丁可靠性并生成清洁支持掩码。路由器在FSS-1000的合成弱支持episode上训练一次后冻结，用于所有目标评估。

Result: 在匹配的弱支持协议下，SADe在9种独立prompt-shot组合中有6种达到最高查询mIoU。使用相同的ProMi查询头，在紧框下与SAM3派生掩码差距在0.03 mIoU以内，在box-r2和box-r4下分别超出11.17和19.49个点。作为插件，SADe在72个匹配框类比较中有70个优于原始支持。在点和涂鸦提示上，平均性能接近原始支持基线。

Conclusion: SADe通过原子证据提供了超越密集相似度的可靠性信息，有效解决了弱标注支持中的干扰问题。它是预测器无关的，可以即插即用，仅需一次训练即可冻结用于所有目标评估，显著提升了FSS模型在弱监督下的表现。

Abstract: Few-shot segmentation (FSS) commonly assumes clean pixel-level support masks, yet practical support supervision often uses boxes, scribbles, coarse masks, or pseudo-masks. These weak annotations may include texture-similar distractors and background context alongside the target, contaminating class prototypes or visual prompts before query prediction. We introduce SADe, a predictor-agnostic support decontamination layer that estimates the reliability of selected support patches without query information. Central to SADe is sparse autoencoder (SAE) atom evidence: dense similarity may respond to both target and texture-similar context, whereas contrasting atom activations inside and outside the weak-support region provides factor-level reliability cues. A lightweight router combines atom evidence with dense similarity and episode statistics to predict patch reliability and generate a cleaned support mask. Trained once on synthetic weak-support episodes from FSS-1000, the router is frozen for all target evaluations. The resulting mask supports standalone prediction or can be supplied to heterogeneous FSS models through native support interfaces without altering query-side inference. Under a matched weak-support protocol, SADe achieves the highest query mIoU in six of nine standalone prompt-shot combinations. With the same ProMi query head, it is within 0.03 mIoU of SAM3-derived masks under tight boxes and surpasses them by 11.17 and 19.49 points under box-r2 and box-r4, respectively. As a plug-in, SADe improves over raw support in 70 of 72 matched box-family comparisons across four frozen downstream models and two datasets. On point and scribble prompts, its average performance remains close to the corresponding raw-support baseline. Ablations and atom-removal controls show that atom evidence contributes reliability information beyond dense similarity.

</details>


### [183] [DreamStyle3D: Efficient 3D Stylized Asset Generation via Dual-Attention Disentanglement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24721)
*Kai Wang,Ziheng Ouyang,Xuying Zhang,Ming-Ming Cheng,Qibin Hou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DreamStyle3D提出了一种基于解耦双交叉注意力机制的原生3D风格化框架，能在10秒内生成高保真、几何一致的风格化3D资产，并构建了约15K的三元组数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖间接的2D到3D风格化流程，难以同时保持风格保真度、几何一致性和生成效率，需要一种原生3D风格化框架来显式解耦风格与几何特征。

Method: 提出解耦双交叉注意力（Decoupled Dual Cross-Attention）机制，显式分离几何特征与风格特征；采用轻量级训练策略增强风格一致性和模型泛化性；构建自动化数据流水线及约15K内容-风格-风格化三元组数据集。

Result: DreamStyle3D能在10秒内生成高保真、几何一致的风格化3D资产，显著提升效率并保持优越的风格质量。

Conclusion: DreamStyle3D为3D内容创作提供了一种高效的新方案，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: With the growth of gaming, animation, and virtual reality industries, the demand for efficient generation of stylized 3D assets is rapidly increasing. However, existing approaches still struggle to jointly preserve style fidelity, geometric consistency, and generation efficiency, as most of them still rely on indirect 2D-to-3D stylization pipelines. This motivates a native 3D stylization framework that can explicitly disentangle style from geometry while remaining efficient. To this end, we propose DreamStyle3D, an efficient framework for stylized 3D asset generation built on a Decoupled Dual Cross-Attention mechanism. Our method explicitly separates geometric and stylistic features to enable efficient style injection while preserving structural consistency, and further adopts a lightweight training strategy to enhance style consistency and model generalization. In addition, we build an automated data pipeline and construct a dataset of about 15K content-style-stylized triplets for training and evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our DreamStyle3D can generate high-fidelity, geometrically consistent stylized 3D assets within 10 seconds, substantially improving efficiency while maintaining superior style quality and offering a new solution for 3D content creation. The code and data are available at https://github.com/HVision-NKU/DreamStyle3D.

</details>


### [184] [Infrared Imaging Empowered by Artificial Intelligence for Pediatric Skeletal Triage: A Narrative Review and Future Perspectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24727)
*Sajad Amiri,Pardis Afshar,Elham Anjomshoa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文综述了将多谱段红外成像与深度学习跨模态翻译相结合的无辐射 pediatric 骨骼创伤分诊框架，利用五种红外光谱窗口和图像翻译网络从非电离数据生成合成X光片，并分析了关键挑战与前景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿科肌肉骨骼创伤占儿科急诊就诊的18%，但诊断仍依赖电离辐射成像。儿童早期累积低剂量辐射会增加终身白血病和脑恶性肿瘤风险，亟需无辐射的分诊替代方案。

Method: 综述了五个红外光谱窗口（650nm–1mm：NIR-I、NIR-II、SWIR、MIR/LWIR、THz）及其双几何（透射/反射）采集模式，总结了图像翻译网络（Pix2Pix、CycleGAN、Swin-Unet）和特征匹配算法（SuperPoint、SuperGlue、ALIKED、LightGlue）用于对齐和融合IR数据以生成放射影像等效重建。

Result: 基于fNIRS和经颅光生物调节证据验证了可行性：近红外光可穿透皮肤、颅骨和皮层用于血流动力学监测，其路径长于 pediatric 前臂或远端肢体的衰减路径。识别出关键障碍包括配对IR/X射线数据集构建、AI医疗器械监管路径、不同体型和肤色的泛化能力、采集协议标准化。

Conclusion: 多谱段红外+AI集成成像是有前景的无辐射 pediatric 骨骼放射学补充方案，需多中心配对数据集、外部验证模型及基于IEC 60825-1标准的IR源安全性认证以推动进展。

Abstract: Background. Pediatric musculoskeletal trauma represents up to 18% of pediatric ED visits, yet diagnosis still depends on ionizing radiography. Cumulative low-dose radiation in early life raises lifetime leukemia and brain malignancy risk, motivating radiation-free triage alternatives. Objective. To synthesize evidence for a hybrid framework coupling broad-spectrum infrared (IR) imaging with deep-learning cross-modal translation to generate clinically interpretable synthetic-radiograph reconstructions from non-ionizing data.
  Approach. We review five IR spectral windows spanning 650 nm to 1 mm - NIR-I, NIR-II, SWIR, MIR/LWIR, and THz - and how dual-geometry (transmission/reflection) acquisition exploits wavelength-specific tissue depth and biochemical sensitivity. We summarize image-to-image translation networks (Pix2Pix, CycleGAN, Swin-Unet) and feature-matching algorithms (SuperPoint, SuperGlue, ALIKED, LightGlue) used to align and fuse IR data into radiograph-equivalent reconstructions.
  Implications. Pediatric anatomy - smaller cross-sections, thinner cortical bone - favors IR penetration, enabling compact, portable, non-ionizing triage hardware. Feasibility is grounded in fNIRS and transcranial photobiomodulation evidence: near-infrared light passes through skin, skull, and cortex with sufficient signal for hemodynamic monitoring - a longer, more attenuating path than through a pediatric forearm or distal leg. Key barriers: paired IR/X-ray dataset construction, AI-as-medical-device regulatory pathways, generalization across body habitus and skin pigmentation, and acquisition-protocol standardization.
  Conclusions. Integrated multi-spectral IR+AI imaging is a promising radiation-free complement to pediatric skeletal radiography. Progress requires multi-center paired datasets, externally validated models, and IR source safety qualification under IEC 60825-1.

</details>


### [185] [MicroZoom: Structure-Preserving Detail Synthesis at Extreme Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24729)
*Huy Huynh,Jingwei Ma,Brian Curless,Ira Kemelmacher-Shlizerman,Steven M. Seitz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MicroZoom是一个生成式框架，能够从标准照片和少量显微特写图像合成无缝的十亿像素级微观纹理图像，实现最高350倍的超分辨率放大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在极端倍率（高达350倍）的参考图像超分辨率任务中，难以同时恢复高保真纹理细节和保持全局大尺度图案结构（如织物编织的重复几何结构），尤其在高损失输入和模糊材料边界处表现不佳。

Method: 采用两阶段级联设计：第一阶段恢复全局图案连贯性，第二阶段细化局部纹理细节；并辅以分割掩码引导模糊边界的合成过程。

Result: 在自采集的日常物品数据集上验证了方法，生成了全局一致、材质真实的十亿像素级图像。

Conclusion: MicroZoom能够基于现实参考材料，在完整物体空间范围内实现可探索的微观纹理可视化，为极端尺度下的生成式图像合成提供了有效方案。

Abstract: We introduce MicroZoom, a generative framework for gigapixel image synthesis at the microscopic scale. Given a standard photograph and a sparse set of consumer-grade microscope close-ups, MicroZoom synthesizes a seamless, gigapixel-resolution image grounded in the material character of the real references, enabling exploratory visualization of microscopic texture across the full spatial extent of an object. Our goal is plausible synthesis, not exact reconstruction. We focus on full-image, reference-based, extreme-scale super-resolution at magnification levels of up to 350x, a setting that introduces two major challenges: (1) recovering texture-specific detail from highly lossy inputs near ambiguous material boundaries, and (2) preserving correct large-scale pattern structure, such as the repeating geometry of a fabric weave, across millions of local predictions. We address these with a two-stage cascaded design, where the first stage recovers global pattern coherence and the second refines local texture detail, supplemented by a segmentation mask to guide synthesis at ambiguous boundaries. We verify our approach on a collection of self-captured everyday objects and demonstrate globally coherent, materially grounded gigapixel imagery.

</details>


### [186] [KANEx: Translating Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks' Interpretability to Medical Explainability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24730)
*Krithi Shailya,Ananya Lakshmi Ravi,Venkatanathan K. V.,Sowmya S. Sundaram,Gokul S. Krishnan,Aditi Anand,Balaraman Ravindran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出KANEx框架，利用KAN的符号透明性增强VLM的可解释性，并设计了KAN-Map热力图生成方法。在MIMIC-CXR数据集上，该方法提升了语义相似性和定位精度，推动了可信医疗AI的发展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有胸部X光分类器结合VLM生成自然语言解释，但仅增加了语言流畅性，未解决底层视觉模型的黑箱问题，导致临床医生信任不足。

Method: 利用KAN的样条函数组件提供的内在可解释性，设计KANEx框架将KAN的符号透明性用于锚定VLM推理；同时提出KAN-Map热力图生成方法，从KAN模型直接推导而非梯度近似。

Result: 在MIMIC-CXR数据集上，基于KAN的ResNet/ViT架构在语义相似性上优于基线，生成的显著性图更忠实；KAN架构将视觉定位和下游推理质量提升了10%。

Conclusion: 将语言解释和视觉归因锚定在数学可解释单元上是迈向可信医疗AI的必要步骤。

Abstract: Computer vision models have become highly effective for medical applications, yet their black-box nature continues to undermine clinician trust. In clinical workflows, chest X-ray classifiers are increasingly paired with Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to generate natural-language explanations. However, these systems add linguistic fluency without addressing the underlying opacity of the visual model. With the emergence of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), whose spline-based components provide inherently interpretable functional units, we investigate whether this architectural transparency can be leveraged to produce more trustworthy textual explanations. We introduce KANEx, the first ever framework that leverages the symbolic transparency of KANs to ground VLM reasoning. This interpretability also made it possible to design KAN-Map, a novel heatmap generation method derived directly from KAN models rather than gradient approximations. We feed these grounded contexts into downstream VLMs for enhanced explainability. Benchmarked on the MIMIC-CXR dataset, we demonstrate that KAN-based architectures with ResNet/ViT baselines demonstrate improved semantic similarity while producing significantly more faithful saliency maps. KAN architectures improve visual localization and downstream reasoning quality by 10%. Our findings suggest that grounding linguistic explanations and visual attributions in mathematically interpretable units is a necessary step toward trustworthy medical AI.

</details>


### [187] [Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance in On-Policy Diffusion Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24731)
*Bingnan Li,Haozhe Wang,Haozhong Xiong,Fangtai Wu,Jinpeng Yu,Yang Shi,Jiaming Liu,Ruihua Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示了在分类器自由引导（CFG）下的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中，传统的引导速度直接匹配目标存在分支级欠定义问题，导致负分支不对称（NBA）失败模式，并提出分支感知的"正方向匹配"（PDM）方法，在稠密到稀疏视频控制任务中实现更鲁棒和有效的知识迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）方法在分类器自由引导（CFG）下的行为尚未被充分理解。CFG是现代扩散系统的默认组件，但现有方法直接将速度匹配扩展到CFG组合预测上，忽略了正负分支的误差补偿问题，导致知识迁移效果不稳定。

Method: 1) 理论分析：证明CFG下的引导速度匹配目标在分支层面是欠定义的，正负分支误差可在组合预测中相互补偿；2) 识别失败模式：通过两个对比案例，发现当共享负条件时匹配有效，而当教师负分支包含学生不可获得的特权信息时，组合目标会导致正负分支误差对抗性增长（负分支不对称NBA）；3) 提出PDM：一种分支感知的OPD目标，分别约束正预测和CFG条件方向。

Result: PDM在稠密到稀疏视频控制任务中，相比朴素引导匹配，对推理引导尺度更不敏感，实现了更鲁棒和有效的知识迁移。

Conclusion: 分支感知的CFG蒸馏策略（如PDM）能有效避免负分支不对称问题，提升扩散模型在条件生成任务中的蒸馏鲁棒性。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) adapts diffusion models by querying a teacher along trajectories generated by the current student, but how it should behave under classifier-free guidance (CFG), a default component of modern diffusion systems, remains poorly understood. Existing OPD methods naturally extend velocity matching to the CFG-composed prediction, directly matching teacher and student guided velocities. We show that this objective is under-identified at the branch level: positive- and negative-branch errors can compensate in the guided prediction. Through two contrasting cases, we find that naive matching remains effective under shared negative conditioning, where both branch errors decrease jointly. When the model's native CFG schema retains privileged information in the teacher's negative branch that is unavailable to the student, however, this joint reduction breaks down and the composed objective induces antagonistic branch-error dynamics, reducing the positive-branch error while increasing the negative-branch error. We term this failure mode Negative Branch Asymmetry (NBA). To address NBA, we introduce Positive--Direction Matching (PDM), a branch-aware OPD objective that separately constrains the positive prediction and the CFG conditional direction. We apply PDM to dense-to-sparse video control, where naive guided matching is highly sensitive to inference guidance scales, while branch-aware supervision enables more robust and effective knowledge transfer.

</details>


### [188] [ClinFusion: A Vision-Centric Multimodal LLM System for Holistic Medical Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24743)
*Hangjie Yuan,Yichen Qian,Zhiwei Tang,Xianzhe Xu,Lirong Wu,Sicheng Yang,Jinwang Wang,Pengju Wang,Zhitao Zeng,Yizeng Han,Yan Xing,Shengxuan Luo,Tao Feng,Qing Xie,Weigen Yao,Yi Yang,Zuozhu Liu,Jiasheng Tang,Shaocheng Wang,Jitao Wang,Jiahong Dong,Weihua Chen,Feng Xu,Fan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ClinFusion是一个面向医学领域的视觉中心多模态大语言模型，通过级联空间感知局部融合算子统一处理2D和3D医学图像，并提出基于视觉的评估框架MedIF-Bench和RoI-grounded方法，在24个基准测试中20个达到SOTA，超越GPT-5.2、Gemini-3-Flash等专有模型，经放射科医师盲审验证其报告质量和对齐度最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在医学领域面临两大挑战：一是需要从异构的2D和3D医学图像中吸收知识，二是评估协议需与放射科医师的临床实践对齐，提供准确、细粒度且基于事实的评估。现有方法在这两方面均存在不足。

Method: 提出组合式级联视觉编码器架构，核心为Cascade Spatial-Aware Locality Fusion（级联空间感知局部融合）算子，统一处理2D和原生3D医学图像；提出视觉驱动的评估框架，包括用于指令跟随评估的MedIF-Bench和基于感兴趣区域（RoI）的临床对齐、事实驱动的报告生成评估方法。

Result: 在涵盖VQA、报告生成、指令跟随的2D/3D多模态医学基准测试中，20/24项超越开源医学MLLMs（如Hulu-Med、Lingshu），13/16项超越GPT-5.2、Gemini-3-Flash等专有模型；放射科医师盲审确认ClinFusion报告质量最优，RoI-grounded指标与专家判断的相关性在所有自动评估指标中最强。

Conclusion: ClinFusion通过视觉中心的架构设计和临床对齐的评估方法，显著提升了医学多模态理解的全面性和可靠性，可进一步结合智能体工具实现检索增强和工具辅助的临床工作流。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) hold immense potential to revolutionize clinical practice, yet deploying them in the medical domain is fundamentally a vision-centric challenge: models must absorb knowledge from heterogeneous 2D and 3D medical images, and evaluation protocols must align with radiologists' clinical practice and provide an accurate, fine-grained and factualness-driven assessment. In this paper, we introduce ClinFusion, a vision-centric MLLM designed for holistic medical understanding that systematically addresses these limitations. We propose a compositional and cascaded vision encoder architecture featuring a Cascade Spatial-Aware Locality Fusion operator that unifies diverse 2D and native 3D medical image understanding within a fused encoder. We further introduce a vision-grounded evaluation framework, including MedIF-Bench for instruction-following assessment and a region-of-interest-grounded method for clinically aligned and factualness-driven report generation evaluation. We show that ClinFusion sets a new state-of-the-art across a comprehensive suite of 2D and 3D multimodal medical benchmarks---spanning visual question answering, report generation, and instruction following---as well as textual medical tasks, outperforming leading open-source medical MLLMs (\textit{e.g.}, Hulu-Med, Lingshu) on 20 out of 24 benchmarks and demonstrating multimodal capabilities better than powerful proprietary models such as GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3-Flash on 13 out of 16 benchmarks, and can be further augmented with agentic tool use for retrieval-augmented and tool-assisted clinical workflows. A blinded evaluation by board-certified radiologists confirms that ClinFusion produces the highest-ranked reports, and validates our RoI-grounded metric as achieving the strongest correlation with expert judgment among all automatic evaluation metrics examined.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [189] [TLRNet: Estimating Individual Treatment Effect based on Local Information and Single Learner Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22762)
*Ali Haghpanah Jahromi,Mohammad Taheri,Zohreh Azimifar*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于深度神经网络和伪单一学习器的异质性处理效应估计方法，在IHDP基准上取得了可接受的结果，为因果推断在个性化服务中的应用提供了新思路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 因果推断在多个领域日益重要，但现有方法在估计处理效应异质性方面仍有不足。同时，观察性数据的大量积累为低成本因果效应估计提供了机会，需要更有效的方法来提升服务个性化工具的性能。

Method: 提出了一种结合深度神经网络与伪单一学习器（pseudo-single learner）的模型结构，使用单一估计器同时估计两个处理组的潜在结果。

Result: 在IHDP基准数据集上与其他最先进方法进行了比较，使用一个估计器估计两个处理组的潜在结果，获得了可接受的结果。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法在异质性处理效应估计上表现良好，为方法的进一步发展和改进奠定了基础。

Abstract: Causal inference has become a central issue across various fields, including computer science, statistics, economics, education, healthcare, and medicine. The broad applicability of this discipline has garnered increased research funding and attention. In recent years, the estimation of causal effects from observational data has gained traction due to the vast amounts of collected data and the lower costs compared to randomized controlled trials. Advances in causal effect estimation methods have enhanced service personalization tools. For instance, these tools can help identify the most effective type of treatment (considering both cost and success rate) for each patient among different medical service options. This paper proposes an innovative method for estimating the heterogeneity of treatment effects. The structure of the proposed model is based on a deep neural network and a pseudo-single learner. The proposed method has been compared with other state-of-the-art methods on the IHDP benchmark. Acceptable results have been obtained by using one estimator to estimate the potential outcomes of two treatment groups. Accordingly, this paves the way for further development and improvement of the proposed method.

</details>


### [190] [Amortized Bayesian Causal Discovery of Extended Factor Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22934)
*Yichen Gu,Yuxuan Song,Weizhou Qian,Yixin Wang,Joshua Welch*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出ABCDFG方法，用于从干预数据中学习因果图，可扩展至数千节点、处理未知目标干预、提供后验分布与可辨识性保证，在模拟和单细胞扰动数据上均达最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果图学习方法（如基于评分的优化和近似贝叶斯推断）无法同时满足大规模扩展、处理未知目标干预、量化不确定性和提供可辨识性保证的需求，亟需一种能兼顾所有这些标准的算法。

Method: 提出Amortized Bayesian Causal Discovery of Extended Factor Graphs (ABCDEFG)方法，通过摊销贝叶斯推断来学习扩展因子图，保证精确无环性，自然处理未知干预目标，并输出后验分布，其MAP估计可证明识别到等价类层面的真实因果图。

Result: 在模拟数据集上达到最先进精度，后验分布校准良好，优于基于评分和近似贝叶斯的先前方法；应用于大规模单细胞扰动数据时，成功识别出已知和新颖的生长因子基因靶点。

Conclusion: ABCDFG方法在可扩展性、未知干预处理、不确定性量化与可辨识性方面均优于现有方法，为大规模因果图发现提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Learning causal graphs from interventional data is a challenging problem with broad applications. In molecular biology, for example, a central goal is to uncover gene regulatory networks from large-scale perturbation data. An ideal algorithm for this task should scale to thousands of nodes, incorporate interventions even when their targets are unknown, quantify uncertainty, and provide identifiability guarantees. However, existing approaches---e.g. approaches using score-based optimization or approximate Bayesian inference---often fail to meet all of these criteria. To address these limitations, we develop Amortized Bayesian Causal Discovery of Extended Factor Graphs (ABCDEFG). Our method guarantees exact acyclicity, scales to graphs with thousands of nodes, and naturally handles interventions even when their targets are unknown. Additionally, ABCDEFG estimates a posterior distribution whose maximum a posteriori estimate provably identifies the true causal graph up to an equivalence class. On simulated datasets, ABCDEFG achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, producing a well-calibrated posterior distribution while outperforming previous score-based and approximate Bayesian methods. Applied to large-scale single-cell perturbation data, ABCDEFG identifies both established and novel gene targets of growth factors.

</details>


### [191] [Modeling Memory-Dependent Reliability of LLMs: A Hidden Markov Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22951)
*Robab Aghazadeh Chakherlou,Siddartha Khastgir,Peter Popov,Xingyu Zhao*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于隐马尔可夫模型的层次化贝叶斯框架，用于在考虑任务间序列依赖性的情况下评估大语言模型的可靠性。实验表明，忽略序列依赖可能导致过度自信的可靠性估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM可靠性评估方法通常假设测试结果是独立的重复试验，但在实际序列交互场景中，后续回答依赖于前序交互的上下文、错误传播或状态演变，这一假设不成立。因此需要更合理的统计推断方法。

Method: 将层次化贝叶斯框架扩展，引入隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）来建模序列依赖：任务结果由潜在交互状态生成，该状态按一阶马尔可夫过程演化，从而捕捉交互上下文的变化。

Result: 在Anthropic Claude和OpenAI模型上，使用四个数据集进行实验，结果表明忽略序列依赖可能导致可靠性估计过于乐观（过置信）。

Conclusion: 在LLM可靠性评估中，考虑任务间的序列依赖性至关重要，否则会得到过度自信且不可靠的评估结果。

Abstract: Reliability assessment of large language models (LLMs) seeks to estimate the probability that a model produces correct responses under a specified operational profile. Conventional benchmark-based evaluation, often summarized by aggregate accuracy, provides a point estimate of performance but does not characterize the uncertainty associated with reliability claims. Currently, statistical inference methods for LLM reliability assessment are emerging. However, a key assumption underlying these models is that test outcomes can be treated as independent repeated trials. This assumption may be inappropriate in sequential settings, where later responses depend on earlier interactions through retained context, error propagation, or an evolving interaction state. We extend a hierarchical Bayesian framework for LLM reliability assessment by relaxing the assumption of independent task outcomes and introducing a Hidden Markov Model to capture sequential dependence in benchmark-constructed interaction sessions. In this formulation, outcomes are generated from a latent interaction state evolving according to a first-order Markov process, capturing changes in interaction context. Through experiments using Anthropic Claude and OpenAI on four datasets, we demonstrate the potential impact of sequential dependence on reliability assessment. The results suggest that ignoring sequential dependence may lead to overconfident reliability estimates.

</details>


### [192] [Variable Importance Identification Through Lazy Training for Binary Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22979)
*Anand Singh,Luke Pennella,Eshan Kabir,Xiaoxi Shen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文针对二分类框架下的深度神经网络可解释性问题，结合变量重要性评估和懒惰训练思想，提出了一种高效的特征重要性识别算法。该方法假设条件少、误差率可控，通过模拟和真实数据验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度神经网络可解释性研究大多聚焦于回归框架，而针对二分类框架的可解释性工作较少。本文旨在填补这一空白，提出一种适用于二分类场景的高效特征重要性识别方法。

Method: 采用变量重要性评估框架，结合懒惰训练（lazy training）思想，设计了一种高效的特征重要性识别算法。算法在最小化假设条件的基础上，保持了可控的误差率。

Result: 通过大量模拟研究和真实数据应用，验证了所提出方法和算法的有效性，表明其在二分类任务中能够准确识别重要特征。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法在二分类框架下能够有效提升深度神经网络的可解释性，且具有理论保证和良好的实证表现。

Abstract: Deep neural networks have been widely used in many applications (e.g., computer vision and natural language processing); however, understanding their explainability remains a challenging task. Recently, substantial research has been devoted to improving the explainability of deep neural networks, with most of this work focusing on the regression framework. In this paper, we instead focus on the binary classification framework and adopt a variable-importance framework combined with the idea of lazy training to propose an efficient algorithm for identifying important features. From a theoretical perspective, our method relies on only a minimal set of assumptions and achieves well-controlled error rates. The validity of the proposed method and algorithm is examined through extensive simulation studies and real-data applications.

</details>


### [193] [Robust Conformalized Selection with Noisy Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22985)
*Chengyao Yu,Hongxin Wei,Bingyi Jing*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出鲁棒共形选择（RCS）框架，通过将标签噪声转化为局部协变量偏移问题，实现了在标定数据受污染情况下对错误发现率（FDR）的有效控制，并保证了渐近FDR控制、功效最优性和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有共形选择方法假定标定数据无噪声，但在实际场景中该假设难以成立，导致FDR失控或功效严重损失。

Method: 通过分别对不同类别进行条件化处理，将棘手的标签噪声转化为局部的协变量偏移问题，进而利用协变量调整的经验贝叶斯型估计来近似错误选择的数量。

Result: 在理论和实验层面均验证了RCS能有效控制FDR，并在合成数据与真实数据上表现出优异性能。

Conclusion: RCS为存在标签污染的共形选择任务提供了统一且有效的解决方案，具备FDR控制、功效最优性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Conformalized selection has been widely applied to select high-quality candidates from large datasets with rigorous uncertainty quantification, such as reliable labeling, drug discovery, and the alignment of large language models. Nevertheless, existing methods assume clean responses on calibration data, an assumption that rarely holds in practice. In this paper, we formulate the above tasks as selecting candidates with true predicted labels or with responses exceeding certain values. We demonstrate that existing conformal selection methods fail to control the false discovery rate (FDR) or suffer from severe power loss under contaminated calibration data. To that end, we propose Robust Conformalized Selection (RCS), a unified framework for selective classification with valid FDR control under general label contamination. The key insight of RCS lies in a novel statistical reduction: by separately conditioning on different classes, we translate the intractable label noise into a localized covariate shift problem, which then enables a covariate-adjusted empirical-Bayes-type estimate of the number of false selections. Statistical properties such as the asymptotic FDR control, power optimality, and robustness of RCS are established. We further develop an instantiation of RCS under randomized response model, and also apply RCS to the task of selecting candidates with large response values. Extensive experiments on both simulated and real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of RCS.

</details>


### [194] [Covariance-Boosted Gaussian Processes for Spatiotemporal Irregularities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23018)
*Jeremy Ovadia*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出协方差增强高斯过程（CBGP）框架，通过增强协方差先验发现非平稳潜在函数，结合部分白化观测的GP建模来迭代更新弱先验，并施加约束防止过拟合及膨胀后验不确定性防止过度自信。在合成和真实数据（尤其是南美电离层风暴数据集）上的实验表明，CBGP能满足三九完整性标准，为卫星增强系统（SBAS）提供更准确可靠的电离层校正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准非平稳GP模型在高参数化协方差结构下，有限采样时容易过拟合且不确定性估计过度自信，在安全关键应用（如SBAS电离层建模）中可能导致误导性预测。

Method: 提出CBGP框架：1) 通过增强协方差先验发现信号和观测变化的非平稳潜在函数；2) 对部分白化的观测进行额外GP建模，以类似梯度下降的方式迭代更新弱先验；3) 增强后对先验协方差施加约束防止过拟合，并膨胀后验不确定性防止模型过度自信。

Result: 在合成数据和真实世界应用中，CBGP通过三九完整性标准的样本外测试。在南美电离层风暴数据集上，CBGP比当前运行的SBAS局部拟合方法更准确可靠，能在最具挑战性的空间天气环境下计算SBAS电离层校正。

Conclusion: CBGP通过协方差增强和不确定性校正，有效解决了非平稳GP在有限采样下的过拟合与过度自信问题，为SBAS等安全关键应用提供了更稳健、更准确的区域建模方案。

Abstract: Nonstationary Gaussian process (GP) models are powerful tools for capturing input-dependent variability by adapting to observed data. However, with limited sampling and highly parameterized covariance structure, they are often prone to overfitting and overconfident uncertainty estimates, potentially leading to misleading predictions in safety-critical applications. Motivated by ionospheric modeling for satellite-based augmentation systems (SBAS), this paper proposes a Covariance-Boosted Gaussian Process (CBGP) framework centered upon boosting covariance priors to discover nonstationary latent functions for signal and observation variation that capture irregularities in the input domain. An additional layer of GP modeling of "partially-whitened" observations guides latent function relative error estimation that is used to iteratively update weak priors in a gradient descent-like procedure. Following boosting, restrictions are imposed upon prior covariances to prevent overfitting while posterior uncertainties are inflated to prevent model overconfidence. CBGP model efficacy and robustness are demonstrated through out-of-sample testing of both simulated and real-world applications that meet a three-nines integrity standard. The modeling of an extensive ionospheric storm dataset over South America suggests accurate and reliable means to compute SBAS ionospheric corrections in the most challenging space weather environment using regional models that are more informed and responsive than local fitting performed by currently-operating SBAS.

</details>


### [195] [Operator Neural Jump ODEs: $L^2$-optimal prediction in function spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23110)
*Florian Krach,Oliver Löthgren,Josef Teichmann*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文将神经跳跃常微分方程（NJ-ODE）从有限维扩展到无穷维函数空间，使得输出过程取值于$L^2$空间而非$\mathbb{R}^{d_X}$，从而无需离散化即可直接处理函数值预测问题（如收益率曲线、波动率曲面）。提出新的近似策略证明收敛性，且条件弱于以往工作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有NJ-ODE系列工作仅适用于有限维随机过程，处理函数值预测问题（如收益率曲线、波动率曲面）时需离散化，导致信息损失。本文旨在将NJ-ODE扩展至无穷维输出空间，避免离散化带来的信息损失。

Method: 借鉴神经算子（Neural Operator）方法的思想，将NJ-ODE框架扩展到无穷维输出过程，使过程$X$取值于$L^2(\Xi, \mathbb{R}^{d_X})$而非$\mathbb{R}^{d_X}$，算子NJ-ODE通过生成条件期望的代表元来逼近最优预测器。并开发了新的近似策略来证明收敛性。

Result: 成功将NJ-ODE扩展至无穷维函数空间，提出了统一的收敛性证明框架，且该证明在有限维情形下也比以往工作所需假设更弱。

Conclusion: 该工作为函数值随机过程的在线最优预测提供了理论框架，无需离散化即可直接处理无穷维问题，且收敛性证明更具一般性。

Abstract: In this paper, we study the extension of Neural Jump ODEs to infinite-dimensional function spaces. In particular, the underlying process $X$ now takes values in $L^2(Ξ, \mathbb{R}^{d_X})$ instead of $\mathbb{R}^{d_X}$ and the Operator NJ-ODE approximates the optimal predictor of this process by producing a representative of the conditional expectation. The NJ-ODE model is a framework for online learning the optimal prediction of continuous-time stochastic processes, given discrete, possibly irregular and incomplete past observations. In a series of works, this model has been extended to deal with generic path-dependent processes, with observation noise and dependent observations, with long-term predictions, and with input-output systems. However, throughout all of these works, the underlying processes were restricted to be finite-dimensional. In particular, function-valued problems, like yield curve or volatility surface predictions, could only be handled through discretization, which inherently leads to a loss of information. In this work, we build on ideas from Neural Operator methods that allow us to extend the NJ-ODE framework to an infinite-dimensional output process. To prove convergence of the NJ-ODE to the optimal prediction process, we develop a new approximation strategy that also generalizes previous works in the finite-dimensional setting by considerably weakening the assumptions.

</details>


### [196] [Adaptive Multi-Scale Forecasting and Gate-Localized Conformal Prediction for Multivariate Nonstationary Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23165)
*Ziling Ma,Junshu Jiang,Ángel López-Oriona,Ying Sun,Hernando Ombao*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出ABF-T-GLCP框架，通过自适应预测状态表示同时进行点预测和共形校准，在非平稳多变量时间序列中实现一致的预测区间覆盖和更高的点预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非平稳多变量时间序列的预测和不确定性量化面临时间动态演变导致的分布偏移挑战，现有方法难以同时保证点预测准确性和预测区间的局部覆盖。

Method: 1) 自适应预测状态表示学习；2) 通过门控机制融合时间专家预测；3) 稀疏预测传递跨相关序列；4) Gate-Localized Conformal Prediction (GLCP) 利用门控状态和时间近因选择局部校准残差进行不确定性校准。

Result: 在大规模高频商品预测基准上，点预测精度一致提升，预测区间显著变窄且经验覆盖率接近名义水平；框架可扩展至金融以外的应用场景。

Conclusion: 共享预测状态表示能够使点预测和预测区间在非平稳时间动态下一致适应，同时保留共形预测的模型无关特性，在温和稳定性条件下实现近似局部覆盖。

Abstract: We propose ABF-T-GLCP, a model-agnostic framework for forecasting and uncertainty quantification in nonstationary multivariate time series. The central idea is to learn an adaptive predictive state representation for point forecasting and reuse it for conformal calibration. The forecasting module combines horizon-specific temporal experts through a learned gate and refines predictions using sparse predictive transfer across related series. The uncertainty module, Gate-Localized Conformal Prediction (GLCP), uses the learned gate state, together with temporal recency, to select locally relevant calibration residuals, thereby coupling uncertainty calibration to the predictive regimes used by the forecasting model. This shared representation allows point forecasts and prediction intervals to adapt consistently under evolving temporal dynamics while retaining the model-agnostic nature of conformal prediction and yielding approximate local coverage under mild stability conditions. Experiments on a large-scale high-frequency commodity forecasting benchmark show consistent gains in point forecasting accuracy and substantially narrower prediction intervals with empirical coverage close to the nominal level. Additional results indicate that the framework extends beyond the motivating financial application.

</details>


### [197] [Beyond ICA: Identifiability by Symmetry Breaking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23182)
*Pengzhou Wu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文证明了具有分段仿射解码器和高斯混合模型先验的深度生成模型在纯无监督条件下的可识别性，通过引入三种代数对比原则（领域对比、机制对比、交互对比）打破对称性，建立了从定律可识别性到映射可识别性再到后验可识别性的层次化结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决深度生成模型在无监督环境下参数不可识别的问题，特别是当解码器非连续、非单射时，传统的可识别性方法失效。作者希望用代数对称性破缺替代连续性假设，实现更一般的可识别性理论。

Method: 提出三种代数对比原则：(1) 领域对比——平凡化混合对称群；(2) 机制对比——确保每个解码器分支被唯一边界见证；(3) 交互对比——禁止潜变量成分与解码器分支之间的参数共谋。利用分段仿射映射的离散组合结构与潜在高斯混合模型的连续对称结构之间的交互作用，用代数对称条件替代连续性，将单射性与结构识别解耦。

Result: 建立了可识别性层次：定律可识别性（LID，潜分布至多到一个全局仿射映射）→ 映射可识别性（MID，解码器同样至多一个仿射映射）→ 后验及逐点可识别性。在分量协方差对角化条件下出现ICA形式的不确定性。据作者所知，这是首个以代数对称性破缺为引擎的非线性可识别性工作，首个允许非连续解码器，首个处理完全非单射解码器（每个观测对应多个潜编码）。

Conclusion: 本文为深度生成模型的可识别性提供了全新的代数视角，打破了传统对连续性和单射性的依赖，拓展了可识别性理论的适用范围。除了交互对比原则外，所有假设仅针对数据生成过程而非学习方法。

Abstract: We prove the identifiability of deep generative models (DGMs) with piecewise-affine (PWA) decoders and Gaussian mixture model (GMM) priors, in a purely unsupervised setting. We introduce three algebraic contrast principles for symmetry breaking: domain contrast, which trivializes the mixture symmetry group; mechanism contrast, which ensures every decoder branch is witnessed by a unique boundary; and interaction contrast, which forbids parameter conspiracies between latent components and decoder branches. Together they exploit the interplay between the discrete combinatorics of the PWA map and the continuous symmetry structure of the latent GMM. Continuity is replaced by algebraic symmetry conditions; injectivity is decoupled from structural identification and required only for pointwise inversion. Our results form a hierarchy: from law identifiability (LID; latent distribution up to a global affine map) through map identifiability (MID; decoder up to the same map) to posterior and pointwise identifiability. The ICA-form ambiguity emerges under conditions on diagonal component covariances. Assumptions are only on the data-generating process, not on learning methods, except for the interaction contrast. To our knowledge this is the first to make algebraic symmetry-breaking the engine of nonlinear identifiability, the first to admit discontinuous decoders, and the first to handle fully non-injective decoders, where every observation admits multiple latent codes.

</details>


### [198] [FedSLIM: Privacy-Preserving Federated MDL-Based Descriptive Pattern Mining Across Data Silos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23236)
*Samar Samir Khalil,Noha S. Tawfik,Marco Spruit*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: FedSLIM是首个基于最小描述长度(MDL)原则的联邦描述性模式挖掘框架，通过两种互补变体在分布式数据库间协同优化压缩模式模型，在不共享原始事务的前提下实现高质量的模式发现，实验表明其能恢复全局信息性模式，弥补了局部优化无法发现的全局模式缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习在预测建模上取得了显著成功，但联邦描述性分析仍未得到充分探索。现有的联邦模式挖掘方法主要基于支持度阈值，缺乏像最小描述长度(MDL)这样的原则性全局目标进行优化。

Method: 提出FedSLIM框架，基于SLIM原则实现分布式数据库间压缩模式模型的协同优化；设计两种互补变体以在不同部署假设下平衡隐私、通信和优化保真度；引入保真度和发现导向的评估指标来量化与集中式基线的一致性及全局信息性模式的恢复效果。

Result: 在多个真实世界数据集上的IID和非IID划分实验表明，两种变体均能保持高质量的压缩结构，同时搜索量比集中式基线低数个数量级；两种变体都能恢复所有独立局部模型中缺失的全局信息性模式。

Conclusion: 联邦MDL挖掘可作为跨分布式数据孤岛的隐私保护描述性分析的实际基础框架；同时揭示了分布式MDL挖掘中存在局部-全局发现缺口，即全局压缩性模式可能无法通过孤立的局部优化发现。

Abstract: Federated learning has achieved considerable success for predictive modelling, yet federated descriptive analytics remains largely unexplored. Existing federated pattern mining approaches are predominantly support-based and do not optimise a principled global objective such as Minimum Description Length (MDL). We introduce FedSLIM, the first federated MDL-based framework for descriptive pattern mining. Building on the SLIM principle, FedSLIM enables collaborative optimisation of compact pattern models across distributed databases without sharing raw transactions. We propose two complementary variants that balance privacy, communication, and optimisation fidelity under different deployment assumptions. To evaluate federated MDL mining, we introduce fidelity and discovery-oriented metrics that quantify agreement with a centralised baseline and assess recovery of globally informative patterns. Experiments on multiple real-world datasets under IID and non-IID partitioning show that both variants preserve high-quality compression structure while requiring orders of magnitude less search than the centralised baseline. We further reveal a local-global discovery gap in distributed MDL mining, where globally compressive patterns may be undiscoverable through isolated local optimisation. Both variants recover globally informative patterns absent from all standalone local models, demonstrating the benefits of federated optimisation beyond independent local mining. These results establish federated MDL mining as a practical foundation for privacy-preserving descriptive analytics across distributed data silos.

</details>


### [199] [Learning Asymptotics with Convergence-Rate Guarantees using Linear Least Squares](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23287)
*Christos N. Efrem*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出渐近学习理论（ALT），将优化与渐近分析相结合，用于从已知渐近展开式中计算未知参数。重点研究了滑动线性最小二乘（sLLSQ）和滑动Tikhonov线性最小二乘（sT-LLSQ）两种数值方法，给出了收敛性和收敛速度的充分条件，并指出了它们的局限性。在解析组合学中展示了应用，数值实验验证了理论结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的渐近分析方法在提取渐近展开式中的未知常数/参数时缺乏统一框架，且传统方法（如比率法及其变体）存在局限性。ALT的提出旨在系统性地解决这一问题。

Method: ALT将优化理论（最小二乘、Tikhonov正则化）与渐近分析结合，提出滑动窗口机制（滑动最小二乘），从已知渐近展开形式中递推估计未知参数，并建立严格的理论保证。

Result: 严格证明了sLLSQ和sT-LLSQ方法在适当条件下收敛到正确参数值并给出收敛速率；同时揭示了在某些情况下方法可能收敛缓慢甚至发散的反直觉现象。

Conclusion: ALT为渐近分析中的参数提取提供了统一且可理论保证的新范式，在解析组合学中有重要应用价值，但目前方法仍存在局限性，未来需进一步探索。

Abstract: We introduce a new research area that is called Asymptotics Learning Theory (ALT) and combines optimization with asymptotic analysis. In particular, ALT provides a unified approach for computing unknown constants/parameters in proven asymptotic expansions using optimization theory. In this paper, we focus on a general asymptotic form which includes a broad class of asymptotics. Furthermore, we study two powerful numerical methods, namely, sliding Linear Least Squares (sLLSQ) and sliding Tikhonov Linear Least Squares (sT-LLSQ). For these techniques we rigorously prove asymptotic estimates that lead to sufficient conditions for convergence (to the correct values of unknown parameters) and convergence-rate guarantees. Despite their strengths, both methods have also limitations, e.g., slow convergence---or even, counterintuitively, divergence---in some cases. Moreover, we present fundamental applications in analytic combinatorics, a beautiful field of mathematics that deals with asymptotic enumeration of discrete structures using complex analysis. The proposed techniques complement existing approaches, such as the ratio method and its variants. Numerical examples also verify the theoretical results. Finally, we discuss interesting research directions in ALT.

</details>


### [200] [Context-Adaptive Inference: A Unified Statistical and Foundation-Model View](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23304)
*Yue Yao,Caleb N. Ellington,Jingyun Jia,Baiheng Chen,Dong Liu,Rikhil Rao,Jiaqi Wang,Samuel Wales-McGrath,Yixin Yang,Zhiyuan Li,Eric P. Xing,Ben Lengerich*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文统一了三种通常被分开处理的上下文自适应推理范式（显式统计自适应、元学习快速自适应、基础模型隐式自适应），将其形式化为共同目标：将上下文c映射到自适应参数θ(c)，然后通过f(x; θ(c))进行预测。在线性预测头和固定特征下，证明显式参数自适应与隐式路由在数学上等价于对输入和上下文联合特征进行核岭回归。基于此提出设计原则和评估指标，并指出开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代预测系统需要根据具体情境调整行为（如临床模型对不同患者不同处理、检索增强模型随证据改变答案、混合专家模型对不同输入路由到不同专家）。现有研究将这三种自适应范式分开处理，缺乏统一视角，作者旨在建立统一框架来理解上下文自适应推理。

Method: 将上下文自适应推理形式化为映射c→θ(c)后预测f(x; θ(c))的统一目标。在线性预测头和固定特征假设下，通过数学推导证明显式参数自适应与隐式路由等价于核岭回归。基于此提出设计原则（自适应效率、路由稳定性、上下文特定鲁棒性）和评估指标，并讨论开放问题。

Result: 证明了显式参数自适应与隐式路由在数学上等价于对输入和上下文联合特征进行核岭回归。提出了实用设计原则和评估指标：自适应效率、路由稳定性、上下文特定鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 统一了三种上下文自适应推理范式，建立了理论桥梁，提出了设计原则和评估指标，并指出了可识别性、分布迁移下的鲁棒性、大规模高效自适应等开放问题，为构建可扩展、可靠、透明的自适应系统提供了指导。

Abstract: Modern predictive systems are expected to adapt their behavior to the specific situation they are facing. A clinical model should not treat every patient the same; a retrieval-augmented model should change its answer when given different evidence; a mixture-of-experts model should route different inputs to different experts. We call this capability context-adaptive inference: before predicting, the system uses information about the current context to specialize its parameters or computation for that instance.
  This article provides a unified view of context-adaptive inference across three traditions that are usually treated separately: (i) explicit adaptation in statistics (e.g. varying-coefficient models, local regression, hierarchical sharing), (ii) rapid task-specific adaptation in meta-learning and transfer, and (iii) implicit adaptation in large foundation models via prompting, retrieval, and expert routing. We formalize these approaches under a common objective: to map context $c$ to adapted parameters $θ(c)$, then to predict via $f(x; θ(c))$. Under squared loss, linear prediction heads, and fixed features, we prove that explicit parameter adaptation and implicit routing are mathematically equivalent to kernel ridge regression on joint features of inputs and context. Building on this bridge, we propose practical design principles and evaluation metrics including adaptation-efficiency, routing stability, and context-specific robustness to guide when to specialize, how to constrain that specialization, and how to audit context-adaptive models in deployment. Finally, we identify open problems in identifiability, robustness under distribution shift, and efficient large-scale adaptation, outlining design principles for methods that are scalable, reliable, and transparent in real-world settings.

</details>


### [201] [Logit-Coordinate Generative Models for Mixed Continuous-Categorical Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23348)
*Yuefei Shen,Xiaotong Shen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文针对混合连续-类别数据的生成建模问题，提出了logit坐标框架用于流匹配和高斯扩散模型，理论分析了其稳定性与非参数速率，实验表明在类别不平衡场景下优于传统one-hot方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合连续-类别数据中，连续变量遵循欧氏空间分布，而类别变量位于概率单纯形上且常高度不平衡，现有连续生成模型（流匹配、高斯扩散）对此缺乏统一有效的表示方法。

Method: 提出logit坐标框架：将类别变量编码为平滑后的自然参数（logit变换），并与变换后的数值变量结合，形成Logit流匹配和Logit扩散的统一公式。引入混合分布差异度量，将类别边际误差与条件连续Wasserstein误差分离，推导稳定性界和非参数速率。

Result: 仿真实验表明，在严重稀有细胞不平衡下缩放logit坐标优于或匹配one-hot坐标。四个真实数据集上，Logit FM在三个数据集中提升了主要分布指标；Block-Conditional Logit FM一致优于平面模型；Logit Diffusion普遍优于或匹配One-Hot Diffusion。

Conclusion: 提出的logit坐标框架有效解决了混合连续-类别数据的生成建模问题，尤其在类别不平衡场景下具有显著优势，理论分析与实验验证相互印证。

Abstract: Mixed continuous--categorical data pose a representation problem for continuous generative models. Flow Matching and Gaussian diffusion operate in Euclidean spaces, whereas categorical laws lie on probability simplices and may be highly imbalanced. We study a logit-coordinate framework that encodes categorical variables as smoothed natural parameters and combines them with transformed numerical variables. This yields common formulations of Logit Flow Matching and Logit Diffusion. We introduce a mixed-distribution discrepancy separating categorical marginal error from conditional continuous Wasserstein error, and derive stability bounds and imbalance-aware nonparametric rates linking vector-field or drift error to decoded mixed-distribution error.
